title: Visa Digital Wallet
applicability: Applies conditionally to Segment 100 transactions carrying the Wallet Method Indicator (Data Segment 111, Table ID 049, Sub Table ID 10) and to staged multi-transaction wallet flows.
source: docs/specs/extracted_text.txt Appendix U-1 (lines ~35624-35653); Wallet Method Indicator field definition (lines ~28543-28565).

businessRequirements.title: The Wallet Method Indicator (Data Segment 111, Table ID 049, Sub Table ID 10) shall use the stated fixed Sub-Table ID/Length and a 1-character value of S or P.

sourceAnchor.section: Data Segment 111 / Table ID 049 / Sub Table ID 10

businessRequirements.title: A Visa Digital Wallet transaction shall be classified as either Pass-through or Staged based on the Wallet Method Indicator value, and the applicable category-specific rules shall govern its processing.
A pass-through Visa Digital Wallet transaction shall preserve the supplied account/token credential and identify the applicable tokenized presentment context.
A pass-through Digital Wallet Operator must ensure the cardholder consents in writing to the use of their account in the wallet before completing a transaction.
A pass-through Digital Wallet Operator must not perform Visa payment services on behalf of another Digital Wallet Operator.
A staged digital wallet Purchase transaction shall use the wallet-assigned account context to pay the retailer while retaining the underlying transaction character.
A staged digital wallet Funding transaction shall use the Visa account supplied to the wallet operator to fund or reimburse the wallet.
Purchase and Funding stages shall retain their individual transaction identity while preserving the wallet relationship and applicable lifecycle references.

Value X is not one of the two stated codes, S or P.
Value S classifies as Appendix U's Staged Digital Wallet category.
Value P classifies as Appendix U's Pass-through Digital Wallet category.
An unrecognized Wallet Method Indicator value cannot be classified into either Appendix U category.
Always REVIEW_REQUIRED by design; no Segment 100/130 field records the originally-stored wallet credential to verify preservation against.

Always REVIEW_REQUIRED by design; DWO exclusivity is a network/operator-registration constraint with no corresponding ATL105 message field.
Always REVIEW_REQUIRED by design; confirming SDWO-assigned account usage requires the SDWO's own account configuration, not an authorization-message field.
Always REVIEW_REQUIRED by design; confirming the cardholder-Visa-account funding linkage requires the SDWO's own account configuration, not an authorization-message field.

Always REVIEW_REQUIRED by design; confirming Purchase/Funding stages belong to the same staged transaction requires correlating multiple messages across a transaction lifecycle, mirroring Appendix R's cross-field BR and Appendix T's echo BR.

testDataReadinessSummary.note: The two format/classification BRs are backed by AppendixUVisaDigitalWalletOracle and AppendixUVisaDigitalWalletOracleTest (19 unit tests). The six business-process/cross-message BRs are deterministic REVIEW_REQUIRED outcomes by design - no corresponding ATL105 message field exists for consent, exclusivity, credential-preservation, or cross-stage correlation.

testDataStatus: AppendixUVisaDigitalWalletOracle implements bounded, structural checks for the Wallet Method Indicator (Data Segment 111, Table ID 049, Sub Table ID 10) - the sole field in the specification anchored to Appendix U - and classifies the resulting Pass-through/Staged category. The six remaining BRs describe cardholder-consent, DWO-exclusivity, and staged Purchase/Funding/correlation business-process rules that have no corresponding Segment 100/130 message field and stay REVIEW_REQUIRED by design, not by omission.
remaining: If a future Segment 111/123 element is ever defined to carry DWO-consent evidence, token/credential linkage, or staged-wallet stage correlation identifiers, encode the corresponding BR as COVERED instead of REVIEW_REQUIRED.
Obtain real AI-generated Wallet Method Indicator artifacts (Sub Table ID 10) to replace the in-repo synthetic fixtures before implementation certification.

If BUYPASS/Visa ever states a concrete token/credential field linking a pass-through wallet transaction to its originally-stored credential, encode BR-SEG100-APPU-PASS-THROUGH as a structural rule instead of REVIEW_REQUIRED.
